scope: Per-item title_mode_top and per-version title_prof. Root/controller/package options are shared template settings, not per-game overrides.

parameters.label: Screen framing
parameters.help: Selects a crop before display scaling. Heights are unchanged. Crop behavior depends on the emulation core; the choices shown match the selected game. Other integers retain the full raster.
parameters.source: TG16 0x7612c; TG16CD 0x7e344; SGX 0x87e64; 63 r2 descriptor probes

parameters.label: Horizontal offset
parameters.help: Adds a signed pixel offset to the crop's source position. A positive value moves the sampled window right/down; a negative value moves it left/up. This does not move the on-screen UI. The native renderer only uses these offsets when an explicit crop is active (or GT screen mode is enabled); full-raster modes otherwise ignore them.
parameters.source: TG16 video descriptor 0x761a0–0x761e6

parameters.label: Vertical offset
parameters.help: Adds a signed pixel offset to the crop's source position. A positive value moves the sampled window right/down; a negative value moves it left/up. This does not move the on-screen UI. The native renderer only uses these offsets when an explicit crop is active (or GT screen mode is enabled); full-raster modes otherwise ignore them.
parameters.source: TG16 video descriptor 0x761a0–0x761e6

parameters.label: Audio gain (dB)
parameters.help: Relative audio gain in decibels: 0 keeps the normal level, +6 is approximately twice the signal amplitude, −6 approximately half. Large positive values can clip. This adds to the engine's driver gain.
parameters.source: emulator.nut init_emulator; native mixer 0x7480c / 0x748a8

parameters.label: Input latency reduction
parameters.help: 0 or less disables run-ahead. N > 0 displays a frame simulated N frames ahead using current inputs, then restores the normal state. It can make controls feel quicker, costs extra CPU, and does not permanently speed up the game.
parameters.source: emulator.nut init_emulator; native task 0x1ed238

parameters.label: Brightness multiplier
parameters.help: Multiplies all displayed RGB channels. 1 is unchanged; 0 is black; values above 1 brighten and may saturate. The emulated VDC palette is unchanged.
parameters.source: emulator.nut init_emulator; EmuView 0x2fe78

parameters.label: Hardware region
parameters.help: The original core recognizes jp and us. jp sets the controller region bit; us clears it. This can affect games that inspect the region, but does not select a PAL refresh rate. Other strings use the Japanese fallback.
parameters.source: TG16 constructor 0x76d30, controller read 0x76528
parameters.values: jp or us are recognized. Other strings use the Japanese hardware fallback.

parameters.label: Controller protocol
parameters.help: Bit mask: 1 enables the five-port multitap; 2 enables the six-button protocol; 4 keeps auxiliary input per port instead of sharing it. Value 5 still uses TWO buttons.
parameters.source: emulator.nut _init_emulator_get_arch_sub_info; 0x77b58 / 0x77b9c

parameters.label: Game timing options
parameters.help: Bit 0 (value 1) moves VBlank IRQ and sprite-table transfer to the start of the next frame (TG16/TG16CD). Bit 2 (value 4) doubles CPU work on scanlines 0–29 and 249–262, TG16 HuCard only. Values 2 and 8 have no identified effect. 5 combines 1 and 4. SGX ignores these options.
parameters.source: 0x349a8; VDC 0x7af60; TG16 frame 0x762c8

parameters.label: Horizontal timing
parameters.help: Adjusts horizontal sequencing, not pixel width. Values 0–9 select the native default of 87; 10–255 use that value. Used by TG16/TG16CD; ignored by SGX.
parameters.source: VDC constructor 0x7a050; horizontal sequencer 0x7b5bc

parameters.label: Keep analog input separate
parameters.help: True disables the normal conversion/merging of the left stick into digital directions. It does not add analog controls to a PC Engine game.
parameters.source: emulator.nut _init_emulator_get_arch_sub_info; native 0x240a2

parameters.label: Stick directions
parameters.help: 4 converts the stick into four cardinal sectors; every other value uses eight-direction handling, allowing diagonals. This affects stick conversion, not the game's controller button count.
parameters.source: emulator.nut _init_emulator_get_arch_sub_info; native 0x240b8 / 0x158b8

parameters.label: Runtime player count
parameters.help: Overrides the profile's runtime player count. It is independent of the player count printed on the menu card.
parameters.source: utils.nut util_get_player_real_num / util_get_player_input_num

parameters.label: Input slot count
parameters.help: Overrides the number of input slots initialized by the wrapper. Without an override it uses the profile input count, then the runtime player count. The engine has ten logical input slots; these are not ten physical ports.
parameters.source: utils.nut util_get_player_real_num / util_get_player_input_num

parameters.label: Rapid-fire speeds
parameters.help: List of offered rapid-fire frequencies. The retail list is [10, 12, 15, 20, 30]. Removing this override restores the controller template's list.
parameters.source: utils.nut util_get_controller_rapid_speed_list; controller rapid menu

parameters.label: Render subdivisions
parameters.help: Two positive integers [X,Y] subdivide the display mesh. This does not split the screen between players. The retail Y setter has a comparison bug, so some transitions can skip rebuilding the mesh.
parameters.source: EmuView 0x311c4 / 0x311d8 / 0x30e24

parameters.label: In-game save memory
parameters.help: Enables the script SRAM adapter for this game. Chronos V2 enables it globally; false disables the adapter for this game. It does not create backup RAM in emulated hardware or enable save states.
parameters.source: utils.nut util_is_sram_support; chronos_library.nut build_profile

parameters.label: Extra machine information
parameters.help: Forwarded to the backend factory, but the TG16, TG16CD and SGX factories do not consume it.
parameters.source: emulator.nut init helpers; TG16/TG16CD/SGX native adapters

parameters.label: Native integer attributes
parameters.help: Each key/value is sent to setAttribute. The PC Engine native callbacks return without applying it. A per-game table replaces the global table.
parameters.source: emulator.nut init helpers; TG16/TG16CD/SGX native adapters

parameters.label: Native string attributes
parameters.help: Per-name overrides are merged with global strings and sent to setString. The PC Engine backends ignore that command.
parameters.source: emulator.nut init helpers; TG16/TG16CD/SGX native adapters

parameters.label: Global string attributes
parameters.help: Read by the script, but its setter call is commented out; no runtime effect.
parameters.source: emulator.nut init helpers; TG16/TG16CD/SGX native adapters

parameters.label: Disable Mega Drive six-button mode
parameters.help: A Mega Drive flag. It does not change the PC Engine controller protocol.
parameters.source: emulator.nut init helpers; TG16/TG16CD/SGX native adapters

parameters.label: Mega Drive multitap
parameters.help: Its reader is commented out in this build; no runtime effect.
parameters.source: emulator.nut init helpers; TG16/TG16CD/SGX native adapters

parameters.label: Emulator subthread
parameters.help: Its reader is commented out in this build; no runtime effect.
parameters.source: emulator.nut init helpers; TG16/TG16CD/SGX native adapters

parameters.label: Menu action
parameters.help: Preserved in title_mode_top. No consumer of this per-item field was found in the shipped selection/demo scripts; changing it has no identified visible effect.
parameters.source: Stock title_mode_top items; menu and demo read audit

parameters.label: Copyright text
parameters.help: Preserved in title_mode_top. No consumer of this per-item field was found in the shipped selection/demo scripts; changing it has no identified visible effect.
parameters.source: Stock title_mode_top items; menu and demo read audit

parameters.label: Description
parameters.help: Preserved in title_mode_top. No consumer of this per-item field was found in the shipped selection/demo scripts; changing it has no identified visible effect.
parameters.source: Stock title_mode_top items; menu and demo read audit

parameters.label: SELECT variant
parameters.help: NO or empty disables the shortcut. Otherwise use an ASCII native tag of at most 14 characters. The menu selects it with SELECT (E) or the hidden variant sequence (S1/S2). Chronos currently gives aliases the same ROM/profile as the primary game.
parameters.source: mode_title_select.nut _resolve_selected_regionTag; title_prof variant map

parameters.label: Hidden variant 1
parameters.help: NO or empty disables the shortcut. Otherwise use an ASCII native tag of at most 14 characters. The menu selects it with SELECT (E) or the hidden variant sequence (S1/S2). Chronos currently gives aliases the same ROM/profile as the primary game.
parameters.source: mode_title_select.nut _resolve_selected_regionTag; title_prof variant map

parameters.label: Hidden variant 2
parameters.help: NO or empty disables the shortcut. Otherwise use an ASCII native tag of at most 14 characters. The menu selects it with SELECT (E) or the hidden variant sequence (S1/S2). Chronos currently gives aliases the same ROM/profile as the primary game.
parameters.source: mode_title_select.nut _resolve_selected_regionTag; title_prof variant map

parameters.label: Japanese name
parameters.help: Menu bookkeeping/name and Japanese display fallback; the normal editor keeps tname in sync.
parameters.source: Stock menu/emulator readers; editor platform mapping
parameters.values: Text; the ordinary editor also updates the Japanese display name.

parameters.label: Japanese display name
parameters.help: Text actually drawn in the Japanese menu view.
parameters.source: Stock menu/emulator readers; editor platform mapping
parameters.values: Text.

parameters.label: English name
parameters.help: tname in the translated menu half; the two views share one game/profile.
parameters.source: Stock menu/emulator readers; editor platform mapping
parameters.values: Text.

parameters.label: Menu player count
parameters.help: Player count displayed on the card and used by the player-count sort; not the runtime input-slot count.
parameters.source: Stock menu/emulator readers; editor platform mapping
parameters.values: Menu player count 1–5 in the editor; native metadata stores a nonnegative integer.

parameters.label: Titlebar
parameters.help: 0 hides the titlebar; 1–12 select a shipped titlebar style.
parameters.source: Stock menu/emulator readers; editor platform mapping
parameters.values: 0 hides the titlebar; 1–12 select the shipped styles.

parameters.label: Packaging
parameters.help: 0/1 select ordinary case colors; 2 selects double-CD packaging; 3 selects the SGX wide sleeve. This changes artwork geometry, not the emulation core.
parameters.source: Stock menu/emulator readers; editor platform mapping
parameters.values: 0 black case, 1 white case, 2 double-CD case, 3 SGX wide sleeve.

parameters.label: Platform / launch packaging
parameters.help: 0 HuCard, 1 SGX, 2 CD, 3 Super CD, 4 Arcade CD; Chronos reserves 10/11 for folder/BACK navigation. The ordinary platform picker also sets arch and System Card.
parameters.source: Stock menu/emulator readers; editor platform mapping
parameters.values: 0 HuCard, 1 SuperGrafx, 2 CD-ROM2, 3 Super CD-ROM2, 4 Arcade CD-ROM2. 10 and 11 are Chronos folder and BACK markers.

parameters.label: Attract-mode duration
parameters.help: Number of menu/emulation ticks (approximately 60 per second), not milliseconds. The demo exits when its incremented counter exceeds this number.
parameters.source: Stock menu/emulator readers; editor platform mapping
parameters.values: Nonnegative whole number of frames (roughly 60 per second); 0 ends the demo at its first counter check.

parameters.label: Emulation core
parameters.help: tg16, tg16cd or sgx; derived from the ordinary platform picker. The editor marker folder is exported as a non-playable tg16 bootstrap.
parameters.source: Stock menu/emulator readers; editor platform mapping
parameters.values: tg16, sgx or tg16cd; folder is a private editor navigation marker.

parameters.label: System Card
parameters.help: super selects Super CD RAM; arcade adds 2 MiB Arcade Card RAM. Any other/absent value selects the base card. Derived from the ordinary platform picker.
parameters.source: Stock menu/emulator readers; editor platform mapping
parameters.values: super, arcade, or another/absent value for the base card.

parameters.label: ROM file
parameters.help: Chosen shared ROM filename; the hook validates the file, rewrites its logical path and omits the encryption suffix .m.
parameters.source: Stock menu/emulator readers; editor platform mapping
parameters.values: A filename selected from the shared ROM store: .pce, .sgx, their encrypted .m forms, or .pcd.

parameters.label: image
parameters.help: Allocated current-folder artwork slot (0–49). Derived from menu order and cover assets.
parameters.source: Chronos identity, catalogue builder and save routing
parameters.values: Generated menu image slot 0–49.

parameters.label: dev_name
parameters.help: Package identity that chooses the title session/resources. Derived from the original template; not a per-game emulation region.
parameters.source: Chronos identity, catalogue builder and save routing
parameters.values: Original package name from the template (PceMini for the stock PC Engine Mini package).

parameters.label: regionTag
parameters.help: Primary native profile key, at most 14 ASCII characters. Chronos keeps it stable for native initialization and save routing.
parameters.source: Chronos identity, catalogue builder and save routing
parameters.values: Generated stable ASCII tag, at most 14 characters.

parameters.label: game_id
parameters.help: Permanent Chronos save identity, not a menu index.
parameters.source: Chronos identity, catalogue builder and save routing
parameters.values: Generated permanent 32-character hexadecimal identity.

parameters.label: save_path
parameters.help: Validated game directory used by the hook to route saves.
parameters.source: Chronos identity, catalogue builder and save routing
parameters.values: Validated relative game directory beneath the library.

parameters.label: save_type
parameters.help: Native save-state type, derived from the core: 11 for CD, 12 for HuCard/SGX, 0 for navigation.
parameters.source: Chronos identity, catalogue builder and save routing
parameters.values: 11 CD, 12 HuCard/SGX, 0 navigation.

parameters.label: systemdata_sram_data_no
parameters.help: Retail per-version SRAM slot override. Chronos V2 uses its managed common working slot and per-game hook routing; this index is not editable.
parameters.source: Chronos identity, catalogue builder and save routing
parameters.values: Retail index; managed common SRAM slot in Chronos V2.

parameters.label: sor_date
parameters.help: Dense sort rank generated from the editor order, genre, name or player count. BACK remains first; ranks are rebuilt for each active folder.
parameters.source: Chronos identity, catalogue builder and save routing
parameters.values: Generated rank 0 to the active entry count minus one; maximum 49.

parameters.label: sor_demo
parameters.help: Dense sort rank generated from the editor order, genre, name or player count. BACK remains first; ranks are rebuilt for each active folder.
parameters.source: Chronos identity, catalogue builder and save routing
parameters.values: Generated rank 0 to the active entry count minus one; maximum 49.

parameters.label: sor_genr
parameters.help: Dense sort rank generated from the editor order, genre, name or player count. BACK remains first; ranks are rebuilt for each active folder.
parameters.source: Chronos identity, catalogue builder and save routing
parameters.values: Generated rank 0 to the active entry count minus one; maximum 49.

parameters.label: sor_name
parameters.help: Dense sort rank generated from the editor order, genre, name or player count. BACK remains first; ranks are rebuilt for each active folder.
parameters.source: Chronos identity, catalogue builder and save routing
parameters.values: Generated rank 0 to the active entry count minus one; maximum 49.

parameters.label: sor_pnum
parameters.help: Dense sort rank generated from the editor order, genre, name or player count. BACK remains first; ranks are rebuilt for each active folder.
parameters.source: Chronos identity, catalogue builder and save routing
parameters.values: Generated rank 0 to the active entry count minus one; maximum 49.

parameters.label: Genre
parameters.help: Selects an editor genre and rebuilds the native genre sort order. It does not change emulation. Genre names are configured in Settings.
parameters.values: 0 means unset; 1 to the number of configured genres selects a genre.
parameters.source: Editor genre list and catalogue sort permutations
